displayedInputs.question:
A circle has been divided into \(6\) sectors of different sizes. Then \(2\) of the sectors are painted red, \(2\) painted green, and \(2\) painted blue so that no two neighboring sectors are painted the same color. One such coloring is shown below.

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

How many different colorings are possible?

A container has a \(1 \times 1\) square bottom, a \(3 \times 3\) open square top, and four congruent trapezoidal sides, as shown. Starting when the container is empty, a hose that runs water at a constant rate takes \(35\) minutes to fill the container up to the midline of the trapezoids.

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

How many more minutes will it take to fill the remainder of the container?

The eight-pointed star, shown in the figure below, is a popular quilting pattern. What percent of the entire \(4\)-by-\(4\) grid is covered by the star?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

The table below shows the ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs that were used to represent different numbers.

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

For example, the number \(32\) was represented by:

[Figure 2](attached-image-5)

What number was represented by the following combination of hieroglyphs?

[Figure 3](attached-image-6)

Betty drives a truck to deliver packages in a neighborhood whose street map is shown below. Betty starts at the factory (labeled \(F\)) and drives to location \(A,\) then \(B,\) then \(C,\) before returning to \(F.\) What is the shortest distance, in blocks, she can drive to complete the route?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

Isaiah cuts open a cardboard cube along some of its edges to form the flat shape shown, which has an area of \(18\) square centimeters. What was the volume of the cube in cubic centimeters?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)

Ningli looks at the \(6\) pairs of numbers directly across from each other on a clock. She takes the average of each pair of numbers. What is the average of the resulting \(6\) numbers?

[Figure 1](attached-image-9)

In the figure below, \(ABCD\) is a rectangle with sides of length \(AB = 5\) inches and \(AD = 3\) inches. Rectangle \(ABCD\) is rotated \(90^\circ\) clockwise around the midpoint of side \(DC\) to give a second rectangle. What is the total area, in square inches, covered by the two overlapping rectangles?

[Figure 1](attached-image-10)
